card.summary: no free tier; K-1 at Rp29.900 a month is the entry plan

free_tier.stated: no free tier; K-1 at Rp29.900 a month is the entry plan

retention.stated: the disk persists while the plan is paid; the service policy describes a prepaid balance that must stay funded

egress.terms: 'Unlimited bandwidth dengan kecepatan jaringan sesuai paket yang dipilih' - unlimited, at the plan's port speed, 100 Mbps on K-3

record.interface_detail: KVM with an OS reinstall and a start/stop panel; the page states 'Kontrol VPS' and 'Full SSD' but does not spell out root
record.tooling: any SSH client; the vendor's own order panel
record.chaining: 4 GiB and 4 vCPU in Jakarta for USD 4.61 a month on the annual term; the highest core count under the line among evaluated providers.

limits.value: bandwidth unlimited at the plan's port speed: 50 Mbps on K-1 and K-2, 100 Mbps on K-3, 1 Gbps on K-4 and above

record.binding_note: the RAM and core count are fixed and the traffic is unlimited, so the port speed is what constrains throughput.

identity_cost.detail: a prepaid-balance account. The vendor's service policy, as returned by search, states 'Kencang Cloud menggunakan sistem prepaid balance'; the payment-methods page itself was not read, so card acceptance, debit acceptance and any hold are unverified.

record.confidence_note: shape, the monthly and annual prices and the port speeds are quoted from the vendor's own price table read. The payment rails and the legal entity are unverified.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'K-3 | 4 CPU | 4 GB | 50 GB | Hingga 100Mbps | Rp99.900 / bulan'
quoted from the annual table: 'K-3 ... 4 CPU | 4 GB | 50 GB | Rp999.900 / tahun' - which is USD 4.61 a month
quoted: 'Unlimited bandwidth dengan kecepatan jaringan sesuai paket yang dipilih.'

record.notes: The monthly price is Rp99.900, USD 5.52, over the line; only the annual prepay of Rp999.900 brings it to USD 4.61, costing USD 55.27 out of pocket once. The annual table lists '1 CPU' on K-3 where the monthly table lists '4 CPU' for the same plan name, a defect on the vendor's page; the shape recorded is the monthly one because it is the more specific.

extras.price_arithmetic: Rp999.900 a year divided by 12 = Rp83.325 a month, times 0.00005528 USD per IDR = USD 4.61 a month. The monthly alternative is Rp99.900 = USD 5.52, over the line.
extras.renewal_note: the annual table carries no separate renewal column; the same Rp999.900 is assumed to renew
